title: Accessibility Statement
meta_description: Commitment to WCAG 2.2 AA, feedback channel, and conformance status per jurisdiction.

blocks.x: Our commitment to WCAG 2.2 Level AA across achalasolutions.com, the measures we maintain, and how to tell us when something is in your way.

This site targets WCAG 2.2 Level AA as the baseline for perceived conformance, informed by Section 508 in the United States, the European Accessibility Act and EN 301 549 in the EU, and equivalent duties in the United Kingdom. Conformance is a claim we hold ourselves to, not a badge we bought.

Semantic landmarks and heading order on every template; visible focus states with a skip-to-content link; color pairs selected against contrast thresholds and never used as the only signal; keyboard operability for menus, diagrams, carousels and forms; text alternatives for informative imagery; and full respect for prefers-reduced-motion, which stills decorative animation while keeping the content complete.

Some interactive schematics convey part of their meaning visually; each carries a text note stating its takeaway, and a long-form description is available on request. Third-party embeds (for example maps or video players) may not yet match our standard — we sequence fixes with the vendor rather than shipping a worse experience silently.

Automated audits run on every template change; manual keyboard and screen-reader passes (NVDA and VoiceOver) run each release train; and findings land in the same backlog as functional defects, prioritized by how many people they block.

If any page blocks you, write to info@achalasolutions.com with the page URL and what failed. Accessibility reports are answered within two business days with either a fix plan or a workaround, and we will provide the requested content through an alternative channel while the fix ships.
